status_logout: This source is not logged in. Configure its account in plugin management.
status_offline: This source is currently unreachable. Check its service address or network.
priorityHint: Drag a handle or use the arrow buttons, then save. These lists only control lyrics and comments. Only enabled sources with confirmed song links are read. Disabled entries keep their order for later and do not participate.
noPrioritySource: No enabled source provides this feature.
noCommentSource: No comment source is available. Match this song to a source that supports comments first.
matchHint: Find a candidate by title, artist, album and duration. The match is played only after confirmation; original audio and playlists are kept.
reorderHint: Drag the handles or use the arrow keys. The server order changes only when saved.
title: Music sources
description: Built-in sources ship with the app and are controlled by switches. Import separate JavaScript plugins as needed; accounts stay independent.
importHint: Choose an original JavaScript plugin from a trusted source. Plugins can make network requests and save their own account data.
methodCount: Declares {count} methods; available features depend on the plugin.
removeHint: Delete {name} and this external plugin or instance’s private account, configuration and plugin playlists? Other instances, the main library, shared caches and original files remain.
offline: Manual local mode or a disconnected network has paused plugin network requests. Local management remains available.
serverHint: For a personal server, enter its address. Platform plugins use the API service required by the original plugin.
qrFailed: Could not create a login QR code. Check the service address and try again.
qrExpired: QR code expired. Generate a new one.
invalidAddress: Enter an HTTP or HTTPS address without embedded credentials.
loginFailed: Plugin login failed. Check the account and service address.
empty: No items yet. Log in to this plugin or choose another section.
deletePlaylistHint: Delete playlist “{name}” from this music service?
unplayable: This plugin cannot currently play this track.
disabled: This plugin is disabled. Enable it in plugin management.
unsupported: This feature is not provided by this plugin, or the service is unavailable.
localSourceHint: Uses the local folders authorized in the app. Select, scan or stop reading folders under Local Music in Settings. This source needs no account.
accountChanged: This song belongs to a previous plugin account or server. Reopen its source before making changes.
preparingPlaylist: Loading the complete playlist before playback…
resumeTrackMissing: The saved song is no longer in this playlist or cannot play now. You can start from the beginning.
prioritySubtitle: Separate reading orders; does not change audio playback
removeInstancesFirst: Delete this external source’s additional instances before deleting the source.
pendingPrioritiesMessage: Save the current lyric and comment source order before leaving?
nextStepHint: The source has been added. Configure it now or return through the source list later.
needAddressHint: Set this source’s server or API address before signing in.
needLoginHint: This source has its own session. Turning it on does not sign you in.
savedLoginHint: A sign-in is saved on this device. It has not been rechecked here; you can check manually.
readyHint: Sign-in succeeded. You can open this source’s music library.
checkUnknownHint: This source did not report a verifiable sign-in status. Sign in or open its library to confirm.
managerGuideSubtitle: Main entries, compatibility and separate accounts
guideCatalog: Built-in sources are already provided. No download or installation is needed; their switches control use. Import plugin is for JavaScript files obtained separately.
guideLifecycle: Turning a source off keeps its account, settings and plugin playlists. Clearing its data requires a separate confirmation. External plugins can be deleted. Other instances, the main library, shared caches and original files remain.
guideNetease: Use the existing main NetEase entry for everyday login and playlists. The original NetEase plugin remains under Advanced with its own account and API session for compatibility. Sessions are not merged or migrated automatically.
sourceCheckFailed: The source was not confirmed ready. Check its connection or sign-in.
logoutFailed: Could not sign out of this source. Please retry.
credentialsRequired: Configure the address, then use a sign-in method supported by this source.
neteaseBuiltInApiHint: The NetEase plugin’s default address uses the app’s built-in API and can usually be kept. Its session remains separate from the native NetEase entry.
notCheckedHint: This source has not been checked here. It only contacts the service when you choose an action.
neteaseSavedLoginHint: This plugin has a saved session. Its original status check cannot verify expiry. Open its library and sign in again if the session has expired.
likeUnknownHint: This source has not fully reported whether this track is liked. You can explicitly choose Like or Unlike.
likeReadFailed: Could not confirm liked status. Check this source’s sign-in or retry later.
likeMemberContextRequired: This source needs the complete liked-list track information to unlike it. Refresh its status, or open the track from this source’s liked playlist.
likeOperationFailed: Could not update liked status. Check this source’s sign-in and retry.
providedSourcesHint: Turn on Kugou or your own media server when needed. Turning them off keeps accounts; the switch itself does not connect to a server.
advancedSourcesHint: The original NetEase and local plugins remain for existing accounts and workflows. Use the existing main entries for everyday NetEase and local music.
developmentSourcesHint: The demo source is for development checks, is off by default and is not a normal music entry.
mainEntriesHint: NetEase playlists and local music already have main entries. They do not require these compatibility plugins to be turned on.
clearData: Clear plugin data and turn off
clearDataHint: Clear the private account, configuration and plugin playlists of {name}, then turn it off? Other instances, the main library, shared caches and original files remain.
dataCleared: This source’s private data was cleared and it is off. Other instances and original files remain.
removed: The external plugin or instance was deleted.
disabledConfigHint: This source is off. You can edit and save its address offline. Sign-in, QR login, sign-out and checks require turning it on explicitly from its source card. No plugin code runs while it is off.
enableBeforeLogin: Turn this source on from its card before signing in.
audioPolicySubtitle: Original platform first; other matches only when allowed
audioPolicySeparate: This switch controls online audio matching, independently of lyric and comment reading order.
audioLocalStep: Use a matched local file or the complete cached audio for this track first.
audioOfficialStep: For online playback, request the complete official NetEase audio first, using the account associated with the current entry.
audioFallbackStep: Try other providers only when official audio is unavailable. Confirm the song match before selecting the highest available quality.
audioFallbackOff: Matching other providers is off. An official-source failure will not start candidate requests.
audioCandidatesHint: This is a candidate set, not a fixed provider-by-provider playback order.
audioPolicyScope: Native NetEase and its original compatibility entry use the same resolution policy. Local files and personal servers keep their own sources.
disabledHint: This source is off and no plugin code or content is read. Accounts and configuration remain. You can save an address first and sign in after turning it on.
audioLibrarySeparate: Library connection switches manage accounts, playlists and plugin features. Audio matching uses an independent candidate set, controlled by the switch in this card.
sourceUnavailable: This source was turned off or removed. Returned to the main library.
integratedSearchHint: Enter keywords to search the current music source.
integratedSearchUnavailable: This source does not provide search.
integratedHomeUnavailable: This source has no home recommendations. Open Library or Search instead.
integratedLibraryUnavailable: This source has no browsable library. Open Home or Search instead.
